verdict.rationale: Circle documents some first-party batch capabilities. The Gateway API has endpoints for batch processing of EIP-3009 authorizations, and the user-controlled wallets API can create one or more wallets in a single call. These are narrow, endpoint-specific primitives, not a general bulk-operations capability across items. Missing for 10: bulk transfers or payouts across many recipients, bulk operations in the CLI or MCP for AI-native workflows, documentation of batch limits and partial-failure handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
